dashboard.label: Better Map - ITSI Service Map
dashboard.description: v1.6 showcase: ITSI service tree rendered as geo-positioned nodes + edges. The demo SPL fabricates a service graph of front-end -> api -> database -> storage with health scores; in production wire it to the ITSI REST endpoint (services + dependencies + health_score). The ITSI integration handles graph fetch + force-directed layout for services without explicit geo coords.
